title: APEBench: A Benchmark for Autoregressive Neural Emulators of PDEs
reasoning: The paper is a technical benchmark for machine learning models (neural emulators) applied to physical systems described by partial differential equations (PDEs). It does not involve the evaluation of religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics. While it contains a standard 'Checklist' and 'Datasheet' addressing ethical documentation requirements for paper submission, these do not constitute a core component of the research or benchmarking goals.
